title: Active Skill State
why: Track loaded skill on the session like working_dir, allow Tab cycling, and inject a synthetic message on change when the user sends their next message. State lives entirely in SessionSkill struct — no Model-level tracking.
outcomes: User can cycle skills with Tab, skill_load sets Next, change is reflected via synthetic message on next turn, persists on save/load, cleared on new session

milestones.name: Config
milestones.objective: Add SessionSkill struct with Current and Next to the Session config
milestones.success: Session file persists both Current and Next, restored on load, footer can read it

tasks.name: Add SessionSkill to config
tasks.what: Add SessionSkill struct and embed it in Session in config/session.go
tasks.why: Self-contained skill state on the session — Current is committed, Next is pending change
acceptance: Both fields always persist (no omitempty)
Default zero value is {"": ""} — no skill

milestones.name: Tab Cycling
milestones.objective: Tab in ModeChat cycles through [none] + registered skills, sets Next, autosaves Current
milestones.success: Tab cycles skills on session.Skill, shows notification, autosaves immediately
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> none
    none --> skillA
    skillA --> skillB
    skillB --> none

tasks.name: Implement cycleSkill on Tab
tasks.what: Intercept Tab in ModeChat to cycle skills, set Next, autosave
tasks.why: Let the user manually switch the loaded skill via Tab
snippet:
case msg.Type == tea.KeyTab && !msg.Alt && m.mode == ModeChat:
    return m.cycleSkill()
acceptance: Tab cycles: empty -> skill1 -> skill2 -> ... -> empty (loop)
If Next is already set, cycling continues from Next (not Current)
Sets Next on session.Skill
Autosaves after each cycle
Shows notification with skill name or [no skill]

milestones.name: Tool Side-Effect
milestones.objective: skill_load tool sets Skill.Next as a side effect, autosaves
milestones.success: After skill_load succeeds, session.Skill.Next is set and autosaved
milestones.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant M as Model
    participant T as Tool Execute Loop
    participant S as skill_load
    M->>T: Execute tool call
    T->>S: skill_load(args)
    S-->>T: result success
    T->>M: if name == skill_load
    T->>M: session.Skill.Next = args.name
    M->>M: autoSave

tasks.name: skill_load sets Next post-execution
tasks.what: Add post-execution hook for skill_load in stream.go next to set_working_dir
tasks.why: When the model calls skill_load, set Skill.Next and autosave so the footer reflects it
acceptance: After successful skill_load, session.Skill.Next is set
Autosaves after setting Next
Failed skill_load does not change Next

milestones.name: Synthetic Message on Send
milestones.objective: On user send, if Next != Current inject synthetic skill-load message, then liquidate Next into Current
milestones.success: Transition produces synthetic with label skill-load and param name; Next is cleared, Current updated; no extra save needed (autosave already ran)
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[sendMessage] --> B{Skill.Next != Skill.Current}
    B -->|yes| C[Generate synthetic skill-load msg]
    B -->|no| D[append user msg]
    C --> E[append synthetic before user msg]
    E --> D
    D --> F[Current = Next, Next = ""]

tasks.name: Inject synthetic skill-load message on send
tasks.what: In sendMessage(), before appending user message, check if Skill.Next != Skill.Current and inject synthetic skill-load message, then liquidate
tasks.why: When the skill has changed, the model needs to know via a synthetic message before the user message
acceptance: empty -> skill: synthetic 'Loaded skill: X' + body, param name=X
skill-A -> skill-B: synthetic 'Skill changed from A to B' + new body, param name=B
skill-A -> empty: synthetic 'Skill A unloaded', param name=empty
Label is skill-load
After synthetic injection, Current = Next, Next cleared
If Next == Current, no synthetic injected

milestones.name: Clear State
milestones.objective: Zero out Skill on new session / incognito
milestones.success: No leftover skill state when starting fresh
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[clearSession] --> B[Skill = SessionSkill{}]
    C[toggleIncognito] --> B

tasks.name: Clear Skill on new session / incognito
tasks.what: Reset session.file.Session.Skill to zero value in clearSession() and toggleIncognito()
tasks.why: A fresh session should not carry over a previously loaded skill
acceptance: clearSession zeros both Current and Next
toggleIncognito zeros both Current and Next

milestones.name: Footer Display
milestones.objective: Footer shows skill state: Next if set, otherwise Current
milestones.success: Footer displays current/pending skill info from SessionSkill

tasks.name: Display skill in footer
tasks.what: Add SessionSkill to FooterData, display it in line2 footer (after auth mode, before working dir)
tasks.why: User needs to see what skill is currently loaded or pending
acceptance: When Next is set, footer shows [skill: Next]
When Next is empty but Current is set, footer shows [skill: Current]
When both empty, no skill label shown
Skill label appears between auth mode and working dir
